description: Utah Municipalities Stormwater Annual Reports is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Andrea Armstrong (deposited on HydroShare). The purpose of this effort is to track longitudinal changes in stormwater organizations’ plans and activities, as represented on annual reports submitted to the Utah Division of Water Quality. Coverage: Utah, United States. The resource was created 2016-07-13 and last updated 2017-06-19; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
